svg.title: FEP Formal family–domain incidence
svg.desc: Editorial family context, not per-topic proof classification. The 22 rows are canonical families and the columns are authored mathematical domains. Teal marks a family-domain association; white marks no label. All values and precise topic contracts are available in positioning.md and positioning.json.
